processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Martensite precipitates in DP590-2 formed during cold rolling; specific temperature, reduction and other processing parameters are not reported.

structures.overall_structure: Cold-rolled dual-phase steel (DP590-2) multiphase microstructure; martensite precipitates are the imaged target and appear as light white streaks (acicular/needle-like) in SEM images.

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Real size (field of view) 56.93 × 42.70 µm; image resolution 1024 × 768 pixels; 21 test images.
characterization_methods.purpose: Capture martensite precipitates (light white streaks) in cold-rolled dual-phase steel DP590-2 for phase (multiphase) segmentation.
characterization_methods.key_findings: Martensite precipitates appear as light white streaks with acicular/needle-like morphology; phase regions contain tiny holes.

computational_details.simulation_method: MatSAM (Materials Segment Anything Model) training-free phase segmentation based on SAM; multiphase category
computational_details.software_used: PyTorch 1.13.1; single Nvidia RTX3090 24 GB GPU
computational_details.potential_model_or_database: SAM (Segment Anything Model) pre-trained on SA-1B dataset
computational_details.boundary_and_initial_conditions: Multiphase category: OTSU thresholding used for pre-segmentation of phase regions; automated structure-aware prompt points (ROI centroid points + grid points, points closer than 3 pixels removed); multi-scale crops of 1/1, 1/4, 1/16 with default overlap ratio 0.5.
computational_details.validation_against_experiment: IoU between MatSAM-segmented masks and expert annotations = 0.82 (±3.1 %), higher than SAM (0.68, ±6.7 %), OTSU (0.66, ±1.3 %) and Adaptive (0.28, ±0.9 %).

unmapped_findings: DP590-2 dataset comprises 21 SEM test images (1024 × 768 pixels) of cold-rolled dual-phase steel; it is an in-house dataset (dashed border in Fig. 1) used for phase segmentation evaluated by IoU, F1 and Recall.
DP590-2 martensite precipitates appear as bright irregular elongated/blocky islands in a darker matrix, with scratch-like surface features visible; phase regions contain tiny holes (Fig. 7e; b0083).
